description: This file defines the RouteBuilder class responsible for rebuilding and managing the routing table in Drupal, including route collection, dispatching events, and route definitions.

classes.name: RouteBuilder
classes.description: Class responsible for rebuilding and managing Drupal's routing table, handling route collection, event dispatching, and route definitions.

methods.name: setRebuildNeeded
methods.description: Marks the route rebuild as needed.

methods.name: rebuild
methods.description: Performs the route rebuilding process, including acquiring locks, collecting routes, dispatching events, and dumping routes.

methods.name: rebuildIfNeeded
methods.description: Rebuilds routes if flagged as needed.

methods.name: destruct
methods.description: Ensures routes are rebuilt once at the end of the request lifecycle.

methods.name: getRouteDefinitions
methods.description: Retrieves all route definitions from YAML files in modules.
